content: When JavaScript Disabled JavaScript Disabled Add To Calendar Download ICS Google Calendar iCalendar Office 365 Outlook Live --> (Date and time are shown in your browser's local time zone) Where RSM 1 Wimpole Street, London Event Type In-Person Pistoia Alliance Loading Map.... 1 Wimpole Street - London Venue Details 51.516244 -0.146854 Join us for the Pistoia Alliance 2027 Annual Spring Members Conference, taking place on March 23–24, 2027, at the Royal Society of Medicine in London. Bringing together leaders, innovators and experts from across the life sciences community, this two-day event offers an opportunity to exchange ideas, explore emerging trends and challenges, and discover how pre-competitive collaboration can accelerate innovation in R&D. Connect with industry peers, gain valuable insights and contribute to discussions shaping the future of life sciences. Register below to secure your place. Sponsorship Opportunities Please contact Catherine Maskell to discuss sponsorship opportunities. Register Please note registration is restricted to members only. If you are interested in purchasing a non member ticket please email Catherine Maskell .
